local-dev.label: dev
local-dev.description: Local development database. Use this for schema checks and ad-hoc queries.

staging.label: stg
staging.description: Staging database. Use when reproducing something that only shows up with staging data.

staging-via-gateway.label: stg-gw
staging-via-gateway.description: Same staging database, reached with the access-gateway account. Use when the direct account is rejected — the two accounts are mutually exclusive depending on whether the gateway is on.

prod.label: prod
prod.description: Production database. Only when the user opens it for a specific investigation, never for exploration.
